# Knowledge Contract Arcana

> Public home for Knowledge Contract research. The specification and experiments are in progress; 3.0.0-draft.1 is a target, not a released protocol.

- Home: https://contract.place/
- Knowledge Contract repository: https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract
- Site source: https://github.com/Arcanada-one/contract-place-site
- Papers: https://contract.place/#papers
- Ecosystem: https://arcanada.ai/
- Architecture article: https://arcanada.ai/en/blog/meaning-management-knowledge-contract-architecture
- Version 2 article: https://arcanada.ai/en/blog/meaning-management-knowledge-contract-v2

## Purpose

Knowledge Contract Arcana is about managing knowledge and its reuse by people and agents: contracts for managing the heritage of human knowledge. It is designed to replace hand-written skills, rules and prompt files kept separately in each agent harness with one unified knowledge contract that evolves itself (evidence-gated, versioned, with rollback) and improves through the community and contributors.

- Working today: public hub, licensing and attribution mechanics (CC BY 4.0, Apache-2.0, NOTICE, ATTRIBUTION.md, CITATION.cff, REUSE, DCO, source register), the knowledge-contract repository as a public scaffold, two published articles on arcanada.ai, the first Meaning Management release in the repository (14 papers and 10 specifications as scientific drafts), and a read-only HTTP API at https://api.contract.place (search, related, fetch over the published documents; measured live 2026-10-31), plus an MCP endpoint at https://api.contract.place/mcp (answered an MCP initialize request 2026-11-03).
- Planned, not built: independent semantic review and a full English translation of the papers, the late research synthesis, a sourced corpus (no approved entries yet), the unified contract for harnesses, the self-evolution loop, community intake and review, knowledge selection with provenance receipts; the read API, the MCP endpoint and the search box on this site are the access routes today.
- The backend engine that processes, admits and evolves contracts stays closed and proprietary; whatever knowledge is published is open.

Read API: https://api.contract.place/v1/search, /v1/related and /v1/fetch (schema ContractPlaceRead/v1). The home page has a search box that calls /v1/search (anonymous GET, no credentials); it lists passages in the order the API returns them and does not state a relevance threshold. MCP endpoint: https://api.contract.place/mcp.

## Papers

Meaning Management, first release: 14 papers and 10 specifications, published as scientific drafts (concept level) in the knowledge-contract repository, listed at https://contract.place/#papers. The late research synthesis is open; independent semantic review has not been performed. Russian full texts are the originals; English entry pages are summaries, not translations; a full English translation has not been started. Text is CC BY 4.0. Updated: 2026-11-03.

- Papers index: https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/papers/README.md
- Specifications index: https://github.com/Arcanada-one/knowledge-contract/blob/main/spec/README.md
